primary_hypothesis: Equal-weight monthly returns of DBS, OCBC and UOB at lag 1 versus changes in Singapore arithmetic mean HDB rent.
validation_status: The later ten months have already been examined in related project experiments. They are reused development evidence, not an untouched final test.
nonfinancial_market_control: Monthly-rebalanced equal-weight return of January 2021 Singapore-listed inception names after excluding all five financial stocks. Do not use a bank-heavy broad index as the only comparator.
inference: Primary monthly regressions on 2022-Jan to 2024-May. Newey-West covariance with three monthly lags; dependent FDR corrections across bank/finance/company/lag tests. Long-window correlations are descriptive and use block length at least as long as the growth window.
forecast: One-month-ahead expanding Ridge, alpha 10, at least twelve mature monthly labels. Rent histories, economic signals and all scaling use only preceding months. Earlier forecasts select model/lag; later period is never used for selection.
scope_limits: The supplied basket excludes financial companies without price series, including insurers not present in the file. No present-day market caps or future financial constituents are used. No submission or TabPFN model changes are requested.
